decision_1_critical_load_failure.name: CRITICAL_LOAD_FAILURE
decision_1_critical_load_failure.approved_rule: Actual validated critical-load service failure (P_critical_served < P_critical_required) is an immediate Emergency trigger.

decision_2_imminent_survivability_failur.name: IMMINENT_SURVIVABILITY_FAILURE
decision_2_imminent_survivability_failur.approved_rule: Emergency may be entered before actual critical-load failure when total available controllable energy over 6 hours is insufficient (M_surv < 0).

decision_3_reserve_deficit.name: RESERVE_DEFICIT
decision_3_reserve_deficit.approved_rule: Reserve deficit alone NEVER triggers Emergency. E_reserve (75.65 kWh / 37.83% SOC) is a normal-mode reserve target.

decision_4_resource_loss.name: RESOURCE_LOSS
decision_4_resource_loss.approved_rule: No arbitrary resource loss combination is an automatic Emergency trigger. Triggered ONLY if remaining resources cannot guarantee 6h critical load.

decision_5_emergency_exit.name: EMERGENCY_EXIT
decision_5_emergency_exit.approved_rule: Automatic return to NORMAL permitted when emergency condition cleared, critical load served, survivability secure, and generation available.

corrected_mathematics.mandatory_rule: 57.83% MUST NOT be reused as Emergency threshold. 37.83% (75.65 kWh) is the Normal-mode reserve target.
